decisions: Benchmarking: Comparing FLUX.1-dev robustness against Stable Diffusion 2.1.

requirements.description: Why does FLUX perform worse under attack compared to SD 2.1? Is the latent space just more sensitive to noise?
Does using a VLM to generate the inversion prompt actually work, or is the reconstruction error (NMSE) still too high to be useful?
What is the false positive rate? Can we statistically separate a watermarked FLUX image from a random noise image with high confidence?
Do we need to tweak the watermark radius or channel parameters specifically for FLUX, or can we use the same settings as SD?
If we don't provide any prompt at all during detection ('No Prompt'), is the system effectively blind?
Is the 'Latent Noise Reconstruction' metric stable enough to be our primary automated check for copyright compliance?
